name: Plutus Card
summary: Plutus Card offers 3-9% cashback in PLU tokens plus monthly perks from 50+ brands like Netflix, Spotify, and Amazon. Stake PLU to unlock higher rewards tiers. Non-custodial with user-controlled keys.

faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
